newsitem.title: USA: HBO CEO sees $335 mln in 96 EBITDA. [CORRECTED 20:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: HBO CEO sees $335 mln in 96 EBITDA. [CORRECTED 20:45 GMT]

text.p: Jeffrey Bewkes, chairman and chief executive of Time Warner Inc's HBO unit, said the paid programming operation will contribute at least $335 million to the parent company's 1996 earnings before income tax at depreciation and amortization.
The expected cash flow exceeds Wall Street estimates, he said in remarks made at a PaineWebber media conference in New York.
Bewkes also said the number of HBO subscribers stands at about 22 million (corrects from 32 million) while Cinemax subscribers number about 10 million.
The final 1996 subscriber count remains subject to adjustment before finalization in mid-January, he said.
